environment.method: native Client, two loopback WireGuard owners, 8 inbound consumers, 2 acquisitions per round, one populated restart; whole-process CPU/RSS/FD includes fixture peers

scope_notes: Partial synthetic native Client stage only; not a full issue #342 pass or an inventory ceiling.
14 completed rounds crossed 603 seconds; elapsed_us includes final verification, real_s also includes initial setup and teardown.
page_p95_us and page_max_us time the combined first-page, descriptor-count and consumer-worker-lock probe, not an isolated page request or HTTP API latency.
CPU, RSS and descriptor counts include all in-process fixture clients and both tunnel owners.
Restart was between completed rounds; restart_rehash_us includes actual rehash of eight active seeds, not full-inventory rehash.
All raw logs and timing retained locally; two earlier interrupted diagnostic attempts were invalidated and are excluded.
